SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
No. S.B.D. 770
Date April 20th, 40

Subject J. J. Kienhuize (Netherlands) - Enquiry re character etc.

Made by D.S.T. Logan. Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

With reference to attached letter, dated
18-4-40, requesting information concerning Mr. J.J.
Kienhuize (Netherlands subject) age about 40 years,
there is nothing detrimental to his character in
Police records.

Since 1936 he has been employed as general
manager of A.J. Klink & Co., 3 Edward Ezra Road,
which firm holds local agencies for numerous
pharmaceutical products and perfumes. Discreet
enquiries among local prominent Netherlands business
men ascertained that Kienhuize recently got rather
heavily in debt as a consequence of adverse business
conditions but he is stated to be making regular
payments and is spoken of by his fellow countrymen
as being reliable. He was engaged in the
import-export business on his own account for many
years in Shanghai prior to 1936 and is stated to
have lost heavily when a tile making factory of his
failed in 1933. Mr. Kienhuize has been married
twice, his first wife was a daughter of Mme. Gingeroff
while the maiden name of his present wife, with whom
he resides at Apt.6, 700 Avenue Petain, was Miss F.
Kaffel.

The following are the only details of
Mr. Kienhuize's movements known to the Police :-

事由：J. J. Kienhuize（荷兰籍）——关于品行等的调查

由 D.S.T. Logan 撰写。由 D. I. Crawford 转呈。

关于所附1940年4月18日来信，信中要求提供有关 J.J. Kienhuize 先生（荷兰籍，年龄约40岁）的信息，警务处档案中并无任何对其品行不利的记录。

自1936年以来，他受雇为爱德华·以撒路3号 A.J. Klink & Co. 公司的总经理，该公司持有多种药品和香水的本地代理权。经向当地知名荷兰商人 discreetly（谨慎地）查询，获悉 Kienhuize 近期因商业环境不利而负债较重，但据称他正在定期还款，且其同胞评价他为人可靠。1936年之前，他在上海自行经营进出口生意多年，据称其拥有的一家瓷砖厂于1933年倒闭时，他遭受了重大损失。Kienhuize 先生结过两次婚，他的第一任妻子是 Gingeroff 夫人的女儿；他目前的妻子婚前姓名为 F. Kaffel 小姐，现与他共同居住于贝当路700号6室。

以下是警务处掌握的 Kienhuize 先生行踪的唯一细节：

Arrived 11-7-39 from Hongkong on "President
Coolidge"
Departed 14-7-39 for Dairen on "Tsingtao Maru"
Arrived 21-8-39 from Dairen on "Hoten Maru"
There is nothing in Police records to show
that he arrived in Shanghai on 4-12-39 from Hongkong.
Despite the fact that Kienhuize is well
spoken of in the local Netherlands community, it is
noteworthy that some years ago P.J. Klink of Klink
& Co., was mentioned as fraternizing with well known
narcotic smugglers, therefore, it is not unreasonable
to presume that as an employee of P.J. Klink & Co.,
Kienhuize may also have come in contact with some of
those individuals.

W. Hogan

尽管 Kienhuize 在当地荷兰社群中口碑良好，但值得注意的是，几年前 Klink & Co. 公司的 P.J. Klink 曾被提及与知名的毒品走私者交往密切，因此，推测作为 P.J. Klink & Co. 公司雇员的 Kienhuize 可能也与其中某些人有过接触，并非毫无道理。
